summary: Our Small Bathrooms collection features beautifully crafted, space-saving pieces that seamlessly blend into any design style, providing a complete, high-performance solution for small bathroom layouts.
title: Unlock Big Style In Small Bathrooms
bodyHtml:
Small Bathrooms Collection

With Studio Bagno's Small Bathrooms Collection, compromising on style for limited bathroom space is a thing of the past. Embrace flawlessly designed, functional pieces that make the most of every square metre.

Explore Small Bathroom Collection

Crafted with Purpose

Our range is beautifully crafted - true space saving pieces that blend harmoniously into your preferred design style, providing a complete, high-performance solution for small bathroom layouts.

Small Bathroom Basin Styles

Available in wall-hung, bench-mounted, semi-recessed, and undercounter styles, these basins are designed to return space to your floorplan, giving the bathroom an open, uncluttered feel.

Wall-hung options free floorspace, while bench-mounted and semi-recessed designs offer flexibility for integrated storage. Undercounter basins, give a streamlined, clean look that are small enough for a vanity unit and practical with their easy to clean installation style.

(original product details unavailable)

Small Bathroom Toilet Styles

Wall-faced and wall-hung pan options are ideal for space-saving. Wall-hung toilets visually expand floor space and make cleaning a breeze, while wall-faced options offer a sleek, flush-to-wall design that reduces dust and clutter.

Both styles maintain Studio Bagno’s commitment to superior functionality and performance but for when that’s not possible, we still carry a range of minimal footprint toilet suite options too.

In-Wall Cisterns & Flush Plates

Designed to be concealed within walls, in-wall cisterns save valuable space and create a streamlined look. Pair with our modern flush button options for a stylish finishing touch that’s both functional and elegant.

Don’t Compromise in Small Spaces

At Studio Bagno, we believe that small spaces deserve the same attention to detail and design quality as larger bathrooms.

See the complete collection and more images by clicking the button below, or call us on (02) 9601 1948 to organise a viewing in our showroom or one of our nationwide distributors.
